pattern: SELECT .* FROM Professionals WHERE professional_id NOT IN \(\s*(SELECT professional_id FROM Treatments)\)
correction: Replace with: SELECT professional_id , role_code , email_address FROM Professionals EXCEPT SELECT T1.professional_id , T1.role_code , T1.email_address FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id

metadata.description: This rule corrects the error where a subquery is used incorrectly to find professionals without treatments, by using EXCEPT and JOIN instead.
